## Stage 3: Post-Call Actions
Fires once, after the AI call ends, from Vapi's "End of Call Report" server message.

In the Vapi Assistant config:
- Server URL -> https://keystoneconsultancy.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/vapi/end-of-call
- Server Messages -> enable ONLY "end-of-call-report"
- Analysis Plan -> add a structured data schema so the assistant extracts: bookingMade (bool), customerName, customerPhone, customerEmail, service, date, time, transferredToManager (bool), transferReason (string). This is what "Extract Call Summary" below reads.

If bookingMade is true: sends the customer a confirmation email and the business a new-booking notification, both via the Resend HTTP API (NOT SMTP - Railway blocks outbound SMTP, so these are plain HTTPS calls instead). Requires a "Resend API" Header Auth credential in n8n with header 'Authorization: Bearer <resend-api-key>', same pattern as the Vapi credential.

Independently, if transferredToManager is true: sends the business a separate FYI email about the transfer. This is purely a post-call record - by the time this webhook fires, the live transfer (Vapi's transferCall tool, mid-conversation) has already happened; this workflow has no way to trigger or affect that transfer itself, only to log it afterwards. Not the same mechanism as the SIP-failure fallback in 01-inbound-ivr (that's a Twilio DialCallStatus callback for a technical connection failure, this is the AI's own uncertainty about the request) - the two are completely independent and can both exist without interacting.

A third, always-on branch ("Log Call To CallLog") writes one row per call - regardless of outcome - to this client's own reportingSheetId (Client Config). Added so workflows/monthly-reporting has a real historical record of call volume/bookings to read - previously this workflow only ever sent emails and kept no log of its own at all.

nodes.name: Email Customer Confirmation
nodes.notes: Resend API - POST /emails. Uses the 'Header Auth account 2' credential (header Authorization: Bearer <resend-api-key>).

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ from: $json.confirmationFromEmail, to: [$json.isDemo ? 'khan.bilalbk408@gmail.com' : $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.customerEmail], subject: `Your booking with ${$json.businessName} is confirmed`, text: `Hi ${$('Extract Call Summary').item.json.customerName},

Your ${$('Extract Call Summary').item.json.service} appointment with ${$json.businessName} is confirmed for ${$('Extract Call Summary').item.json.bookingDate} at ${$('Extract Call Summary').item.json.bookingTime}.

If you need to change or cancel, just call us back.

Thanks,
${$json.businessName}` }) }}

nodes.name: Email Business Notification
nodes.notes: Resend API - POST /emails. Uses the 'Header Auth account 2' credential (header Authorization: Bearer <resend-api-key>).

nodes.name: Log Call To CallLog
nodes.notes: Raw Sheets REST API - values:append (POST, not the values.get/update/clear verbs used elsewhere in this project so far - this is the first use of the append verb here). Logs every call regardless of outcome, since this is the only historical record of call volume at all - Monthly Reporting reads this sheet for 'calls answered'/'bookings made'. Requires reportingSheetId to be set in Client Config to a real sheet with a CallLog tab whose row 1 has headers matching this row's order (timestamp, clientId, callerNumber, bookingMade, transferredToManager, service, date, time) - see workflows/monthly-reporting/README.md. onError: continueRegularOutput so a logging failure (e.g. blank/placeholder reportingSheetId) can never block Acknowledge or the other notification branches.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ values: [[ new Date().toISOString(), $json.clientId, $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.customerPhone || '', $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.bookingMade, $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.transferredToManager, $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.service || '', $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.bookingDate || '', $('Extract Call Summary').item.json.bookingTime || '' ]] }) }}

nodes.name: Was Transferred To Manager?
nodes.notes: Independent of "Was A Booking Made?" - both read from the same Extract Call Summary/Get Client Config output, so either or both notifications can fire for the same call (a caller could get booked for one thing and separately get confused about something else later in the same conversation).

nodes.name: Email Business - Manager Transfer Alert
nodes.notes: Resend API - POST /emails. Uses the 'Header Auth account 2' credential. Purely informational - the live transfer already happened via Vapi's transferCall tool by the time this fires; this just gives the business a searchable record of why, since a live transfer otherwise leaves no trace in this system at all.
